notes: Do not claim guaranteed tender wins.
Do not claim paying clients exist.
Mention that the Hostinger dashboard is live and the VPS production pipeline is unverified where appropriate.

templates.connection_message: Hi {first_name}, I am testing a tender intelligence dashboard for construction and civils bid teams. It helps spot shortlisted opportunities, buyer patterns, and timing signals. Thought it may be relevant to your role.
templates.follow_up_1: Thanks for connecting, {first_name}. I am running a small 2-week validation pilot for ProcessEd. The live demo is a Hostinger dashboard using TenderNed metadata, with 50 tenders loaded, 21 shortlisted, and 45 buyers tracked.
templates.follow_up_2: The idea is simple: reduce manual portal scanning by turning tender metadata into a shortlist, buyer watchlist, and timing-ready opportunity view. It is not automated bid submission or a promise of tender wins. It is a faster review layer for human bid judgement.
templates.demo_ask: Would a 15-20 minute walkthrough be useful? I can show the live dashboard, the top opportunities, and how a 2-week pilot would measure relevance, time saved, and buyer insight usefulness.
templates.soft_close: No pressure if this is not a current priority. I can either leave it here or send a short example of the weekly summary format so you can judge whether it is useful later.
